# Year 12 Task 4: Unit 3 exam blueprint

2027 planning draft · Blueprint; full paper/key not yet authored. Original content CC BY 4.0; example code MIT. Public planning material, not a secure school-issued assessment.

An exam construction blueprint. Full papers and secure marking keys remain to be authored.

## Placement

- Type: Examination
- Course weight: 15% (standard task for this slot)
- Proposed local timing: S1 W17–18 exam block, according to the school timetable.
- Content family: Unit 3 representative sample, including networking

## Scope and required evidence

- Suggested school paper: 10 minutes reading plus 3 hours working. Use a 40% short-answer and 60% extended-answer balance, with new original stimuli.
- Sample the taught Unit 3 content. Build a content/demand/marks matrix and an item-specific key.
- Prepare accessible diagrams, checking time and an independently moderated marking guide. The Year 12 external design specifies 10 minutes reading plus 3 hours working, 20–30 short questions and 4–6 extended questions.

## Resources and setup

- Included exam blueprint CSV and paper-review checklist.
- Current syllabus examination design brief and school examination procedures.
- Existing open practice papers are revision resources, not secure full exams.

## Initial acceptance checks / paper review

- Check content coverage, question count, section totals and realistic timing.
- Trial every code/SQL stimulus and verify all computed answers independently.
## Conditions to finalise before issue

Teacher sets issue/due dates, permitted references/AI/assistance, supervised-work arrangements, individual-authorship evidence, approved adjustments and the item-level key. Record milestones and use an explanation or small change demonstration to authenticate the same task. Fresh controlled tests and exam keys must be developed privately. Public practice answers cannot establish assessment security.

This is the standard task in its existing slot. It does not add another task to the eight-task outline. Refer to teacher-release-checklist.md and coverage-and-release.md before use.
